body:
Implements GRAMMAR.md §1's full lexical grammar -- exact codepoint table, variation-selector matching rule (strip trailing VS15/VS16, reject ZWJ as fatal), VECLIT as one exact literal token. 5 real tests pass: GRAMMAR.md's own worked example, the repo's existing examples/xor_check.llll sample, VS16 equivalence, ZWJ rejection, unrecognized-char handling. go build/test/vet clean. Parser/emitter still to come -- lexer only so far. LO commit 5f74f69.

⚓ ☃
title: Phase 1 begins: real LO lexer (internal/lexer, Go)
